An Australian Hyrox champion has sparked a heated debate after continuing to compete in a Beijing race after losing control of her bowels mid-event. Footage of the incident went viral, with some questioning why she was allowed to continue while others praised her determination to finish. Hyrox said it carried out a 'major cleanup operation,' including disinfecting equipment and replacing affected sections of carpet, while urging people not to target the athlete. The athlete was later identified online and received threats, prompting Hyrox to warn that anyone threatening or encouraging harm against her would be permanently banned from its events. #hyrox #news #beijing #sport #viral
